title: Quick-BBQ Russian Pork Back Ribs Grill
description: Fast, flavorful BBQ pork back ribs with a Russian twist, using binchotan charcoal for a unique smoky flavor. Perfect for a quick dinner or barbecue party.

ingredients.name: binchotan charcoal
ingredients.notes: available at Asian markets or online

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 375°F (190°C).
In a small bowl, mix together Russian seasoning blend, brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Apply the seasoning mixture evenly to both sides of the pork ribs, making sure to coat them completely.
Place the pork ribs on the grill and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until nicely charred.
In a small saucepan, combine BBQ sauce, apple cider vinegar, water, and honey. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Brush the BBQ sauce mixture evenly over both sides of the pork ribs, making sure to coat them completely.
Continue to cook the pork ribs for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Remove the pork ribs from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh dill, if desired.
